meso_d4_v7_closed.verdict: CLOSED at SS 60 ps / FF 25 ps, physically clean. Zero added latency: every crossing term (slot valid / lap) is a two-level AND-OR of write-domain flops with REGISTERED one-hot read-domain selects (placed and advanced with the pointer), and it only drives a kept 2:1 select between next states precomputed from local flops; the 512-bit data select has one one-hot index register per 64-bit chunk. Campaign on this source is cycle-identical to v4.

verdict: Function: the reset-placed ring FIFO passes 323M words with 0 errors, 0 false faults and 0 window violations across 0..360 deg and 2w wander placed at either extreme; drift fails closed before any window violation; 3/3 mutants caught.

Measured delta at central wander: 2 periods a crossing (1 ring placement + 1 capture register), 4 a region round trip (5 at the half-period resolution edge), 2x the model's central 2. Option C costs Qwen -0.235% (calibrated) / -0.44% (near-HBM), DS -0.273%; worst phase -0.29/-0.55%, -0.34%. B's whole gain over C stays < 1%: C stands.
Not yet adoptable: W=512 D4 has not closed SS at 1.2 GHz (best measured -29.96 ps, v3); v4 is queued. The forwarded stage is not qualified over a 430.56 um span in a standalone ORFS fixture.
